sources.title: 風しんに関するQ&A｜妊娠中又は妊娠の可能性がある方へ
sources.currentness: Current MHLW rubella Q&A rechecked 2026-08-13. Pregnant women cannot receive rubella/MR live vaccine; low-antibody pregnant women should reduce exposure risk and are advised to consider vaccination after delivery.
sources.reuse: Use current public-health facts in original wording; do not reproduce Q&A passages, illustrations or leaflets.
